items.title: Winners And Losers Of Q2: Marriott (NASDAQ:MAR) Vs The Rest Of The Consumer Discretionary - Travel and Vacation Providers Stocks
items.summary: As the craze of earnings season draws to a close, here’s a look back at some of the most exciting (and some less so) results from Q2. Today, we are looking at consumer discretionary - travel and vacation providers stocks, starting with Marriott (NASDAQ:MAR).

items.title: Summer Travel Season May Be Ending, but Marriott’s Stock Is Worth Checking In For
items.summary: With summer winding down and vacations drawing to a close, more people are probably checking out of a  Marriott International  hotel than checking in.  Marriott, along with  Hilton Worldwide Holdings  is one of two major global hotel brands that dominate the industry.  It operates a lucrative asset-light business model, in which franchised properties provide healthy cash flow.

items.title: Marriott (MAR) Launches Luxury Collection Expeditions In Japan, Italy And Greece
items.summary: Marriott International (NasdaqGS:MAR) has launched The Luxury Collection Expeditions, a series of culturally immersive journeys in destinations such as Japan, Italy, and Greece. The new offering extends The Luxury Collection brand beyond hotel stays into guided, experience-led travel. Expeditions are designed around local culture, cuisine, and heritage, aiming to deepen guest engagement with each destination.
